prompts.math: Theorem. Let G be a finite group and H a subgroup of G. Then the order of H divides the order of G. Proof. The left cosets of H partition G, and each coset gH has the same cardinality as H, since h -> gh is a bijection. Hence |G| = [G:H] * |H|.
prompts.prose: The question of how memory works has occupied philosophers and scientists for centuries. When we recall an event, we do not replay a recording; we reconstruct it, and the reconstruction is shaped by everything we have learned since. This is why eyewitness testimony is less reliable than juries assume.
